entries.en: The fuck did I just say? It ain't workin', all right?
entries.ro: Ce dracu' am zis? Nu merge, bine?

entries.en: Yeah, it's a scorcher, all right. Once you're finished, start bringing them inside, hm?
entries.ro: Da, e de plesnești de cald. Când termini, începe să-i aduci înăuntru, nu?

entries.en: Yeah, just about. Sorry, heat's slowin' me down a bit...
entries.ro: Da, aproape. Scuze, de la căldură abia mă mișc...

entries.en: What? No, it doesn't shoot, doesn't turn, doesn't do fuck-all!
entries.ro: Ce? Nu, nu trage, nu se întoarce, nu face nimic, pula mea!

entries.en: Turn off and-- Are you fucking kidding me?!
entries.ro: Oprește și-- Faci mișto de mine, pula mea?!
